title: Danger, Dr. Danfield
identity_notes: Crime/detective drama built around criminal psychologist Dr. Daniel Danfield dictating solved cases to secretary Rusty Fairfax. The frozen GRH set contains the complete 26-program circulating transcription sequence through Feb. 9, 1947; specialist histories place the ABC network series through Apr. 13, 1947, so survival-package scope and network-airing scope are retained separately.

historical_context.title: ABC network and Knox sponsorship
historical_context.description: Contemporary Radio Life and ratings evidence place Danger, Dr. Danfield on ABC under Knox Company sponsorship.

historical_context.title: Criminal psychologist as radio detective
historical_context.description: The series centers a criminal psychologist who analyzes cases and explains solutions to secretary Rusty Fairfax.

historical_context.title: Surviving package versus longer network chronology
historical_context.description: The frozen 26 programs end Feb. 9, 1947 while OTRR/reference histories place the ABC series through Apr. 13, 1947; the database keeps those scopes distinct.

historical_context.title: Teleways transcription and syndication model
historical_context.description: The programs were produced as transcriptions by Teleways, supporting later syndication and the unusually coherent 26-program circulating set.
